name: calendar
title: Calendar with dates
shows: A month with one dated range and, under it, the dates that matter as rows (date tile, title, one line). The pointer sets the range; each row lights up as its day is reached.
edit: data-start, data-end and data-month on the root set the range (the client's real dates); is-mark on one day rings a single date; each [data-ev] row is one dated event (its day, title and one line). Mark today with is-today. No Apply or Clear: it shows a plan, not a picker.
loop: about 3.2 s a cycle: the pointer sets the range, the dated rows light up, it points at the marked date; the finished picture holds for at most 15% of the cycle; restarts when the pointer enters its card
